checks.message: Provisional boundary is present and fully disclosed. It may support intake self-check and content scoring, but must be replaced and all precision-sensitive metrics recalculated when official geometry is supplied.
Three required key areas are provisional and fully disclosed. Content scoring remains eligible; official polygons are required before any precise area, redline, approval, or statutory-control claim.
Land-use polygons preserve the submitted boundary partitioning and add the Jing-Zhang Synapse Loop coordination strategy without changing topology.
Static offline visualization carries the same provisional-data disclosure, metrics, task coverage, and human-review boundary as the proposal.
Proposal includes references to standards, design depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, and assumptions.
